title: 第18章 执着还是固执？
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
安怜走出宿舍楼，沿着主路往学院办公区的方向走。

    她走得很慢，不是因为她在犹豫，是因为她的腰太酸了。

    叶闻白那个混蛋。

    真是够了。

    她一个光月觉醒者，全大陆最稀有的魔法天赋持有者，圣罗兰学院年级第二的学霸，居然被男人折腾得连路都走不稳。

    说出去都没人信。

    安怜一边走一边在心里给自己未来的男朋友列表加了一条硬性规定：体力不能太好。

    算了，这条规定加了也没用，反正她也没打算谈下一段恋爱。

    等她攒够钱跑路到北方冰雪王国，她就一个人安安静静地过日子，养只猫，种种花，再也不碰男人了。

    安怜想着想着，没一会就走到了学院办公区。

    负责此次秘境选拔的部门在办公区三楼，安怜爬上楼梯，拐过走廊，然后——

    她愣在了原地。

    走廊里全是人。

    她粗略感知了一下，至少有三十个人，男女老少都有。

    有些人穿着圣罗兰学院的校服，看起来和她一样是在校学生；有些人穿着便装，年龄明显大一些，应该已经毕业了；还有些人头发都花白了，脸上的皱纹很深，少说也有五六十岁。

    所有人的手里都拿着一个东西。

    一枚徽章。

    光月觉醒者身份的象征。

    由大陆魔法师协会统一颁发，上面刻着持有者的名字、元素属性和天赋评级。

    每个光月觉醒者都有一枚，而且是唯一的身份凭证，丢了补办非常麻烦，所以大家平时都保管得很好，轻易不会拿出来。

    但月影回廊报名必须用到这枚徽章。

    因为秘境事关重大，涉及到进入资格的审核和确认，不能由他人代为报名，只能由本人亲自到现场，把徽章交到工作组成员手中，由工作人员现场核对身份信息、录入系统、完成报名程序。
content_en:
An Lian walked out of the dormitory building and walked along the main road towards the college office area.

    She walked slowly, not because she was hesitating, but because her waist was too sore.

    That bastard Ye Wenbai.

    That's enough.

    She was a Light and Moon Awakener, the rarest magic talent holder in the entire continent, and the second-grade top student at St. Laurent Academy. She was tormented by a man to the point where she couldn't even walk steadily.

    No one would believe it.

    As An Lian walked, she mentally added a hard rule to her list of future boyfriends: her physical strength should not be too good.

    Forget it, it's useless to add this rule. She doesn't plan to have another relationship anyway.

    When she saves enough money to run away to the northern ice and snow kingdom, she will live quietly by herself, raising a cat, growing flowers, and never touching a man again.

    An Lian thought about it and walked to the college office area after a while.

    The department responsible for this secret realm selection was on the third floor of the office area. An Lian climbed up the stairs, turned around the corridor, and then——

    She froze in place.

    The corridor was full of people.

    She roughly sensed that there were at least thirty people, including men, women, and children.

    Some people were wearing the uniforms of Saint Laurent College and looked like students at the school like her; some were wearing casual clothes and were obviously older and should have graduated; others had gray hair and deep wrinkles on their faces, and they were at least fifty or sixty years old.

    Everyone is holding something in their hands.

    A badge.

    A symbol of identity for those who have awakened light and moon.

    Issued by the Continental Magicians Association, it is engraved with the holder's name, elemental attributes and talent rating.

    Every Light Moon Awakener has one, and it is the only identity certificate. It is very troublesome to replace it if it is lost, so everyone usually keeps it very well and does not take it out easily.

    However, this badge must be used to register for the Moon Shadow Corridor.

    Because the secret realm is of great importance and involves the review and confirmation of entry qualifications, others cannot register on your behalf. You can only go to the site in person and hand the badge to the working group members. The staff will check the identity information on site, enter it into the system, and complete the registration process.
